svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A station-corrections registry record ships four independently obtainable facts — name, context, position and provider — and deliberately carries no provider-minted station id, because the CHS id has no source other than the licensed IWLS API and is resolved at runtime instead.
svg.text: One registry record: four facts that ship, one handle that never does
SHIPS — obtained independently; anyone is free to publish these

g.text: hand-written label, re-cased from a survey label
own fitting pipeline, audited against a chart

svg.text: NEVER SHIPS — the one field with no independent origin

g.text: no independent origin — the only source is
CHS's licensed IWLS API. Resolved at runtime,
on the operator's box, and never written to disk.

svg.text: The public join key is the station name (and its stable slug) — a fact anyone is free to publish.
